experiments.finding: No ranking skill beyond picking at random from the same pool; no frozen setting was positive in both validation and test.
No hypothesis supported for near, next or far expiry, nor for cross-expiry agreement or state transitions; near-month short build-up is inconclusive (permutation p 0.06).

research.note: Every threshold and weight on this screen is a research setting, not a validated one. The ranking orders candidates for review; it is not a proven selection method, and back-tests found no skill beyond a random pick from the same pool.

disclosure: These are heuristic readings of two figures (futures price and open interest), not proof of what traders intended. Rollovers, expiry and changes in who trades a contract distort them. Signal Strength, Tradeability and Strategy Quality are kept as separate scores and never blended; a missing input leaves its points unearned and is shown, it is not redistributed. All weights and thresholds are research settings that no out-of-sample test has validated. Fundamental quality is a separate context panel and is not part of any score. Research and hypothetical scenarios only: nothing here is advice and nothing is sent to a broker.
